How do I start a return or an exchange?

Bellesa products are all final sale, so there isn’t a return or exchange process. Due to the intimate nature of our products, we can’t accept returns or exchanges for health and hygiene reasons—once items leave our warehouse, they’re considered used and can’t be returned, even if unopened.
